Thanks for the ping, Vanessa. High-level thoughts from product/compliance side:

- Audit coverage: we can produce request-level audit rows with the following fields reliably: timestamp, api_key_id, request_id, model_id, endpoint, response_status, and a pointer to whether the response triggered a PII tag in our pipeline. We do NOT currently surface model-internal token-level outputs in exports (that would be a much heavier export).

- SSO events: we can export provisioning/auth events filtered by time range and identity provider (Okta). That will show the provisioning and first-login windows Ari mentioned.

- Retention export: engineering can create a tenant-scoped export for 90 days, but we need to ensure we apply redaction rules for user text (PII). Proposal: deliver CSV with metadata rows and a small sample of redacted request bodies (hashes + redaction markers) rather than raw content. Legal will need to sign off.

Marissa — can you confirm whether the playbook's redaction steps match our supported tooling? If not, inventory of manual redactions will be needed.

My recommended prioritization: P1 (evidence) + require Legal sign-off on the BYOK carve before any key-handling changes. We should also require a doc-signed temporary exception (7-14 day window) and a rollback plan.

I'll hold on the product feasibility work pending the owners and timeline.

Grace
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
